## What's new
- **New theme: Matrix** – pure black with phosphor-green text and accent
- **Dracula** reworked – a very dark wine-red background with a red accent
- **Tokyo Night** – the accent is now magenta
- **Better button contrast** – text on accent-coloured buttons now uses whichever of dark or white text contrasts more, so bright accents (red, magenta, green) stay readable

Choose a theme in **⚙ Settings → Appearance → Theme**.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.4.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept. If you use Dracula or Tokyo Night, the new colours apply automatically.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.3.1...v1.4.0
